verdict.rationale: Zulip's first-party docs give an installer for running a self-hosted server and state that self-hosters get the same software as Zulip Cloud. Export/import tools allow moving between Cloud and your own servers, and community users confirm running their own instances on fully open-source code. Community reports of install friction (Debian/Ubuntu-only, a dedicated server or VM, 4GB RAM recommended) limit the experience but do not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: evidence of broad OS support and a well-working container deployment.
